export default function AdminPaymentReconciliationPage() { const { status } = useSession() const router = useRouter() const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true) const [overview, setOverview] = useState({ totalTransactions: 0, totalRevenue: 0, totalProcessorFees: 0, totalPlatformFees: 0, totalPayouts: 0, pendingPayouts: 0, }) const [transactions, setTransactions] = useState([]) const useState({ processor: '', startDate: '', endDate: '', }) const [page, setPage] = useState(1) const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1) useEffect(() => { if (status === 'unauthenticated') { router.push('/auth/signin') } }, [status, router]) useEffect(() => { if (status === 'authenticated') { fetchReconciliationData() } }, [status, page, filters]) const fetchReconciliationData = async () filters.startDate }), ...(filters.endDate && { endDate: filters.endDate }), }) const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/payment-reconciliation?${params}`) if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch reconciliation data') const data = await res.json() setTransactions(data.transactions) setOverview(data.overview) setReports(data.reconciliationReports) setProcessorSummaries(data.processorSummaries) setStatusBreakdown(data.statusBreakdown) setTotalPages(data.pagination.pages) } catch (error) { console.error('Error:', error) toast.error('Failed to load reconciliation data') } finally { setLoading(false) } } const getPayoutStatusColor = (status: string) => { switch (status) { case 'COMPLETED': return 'bg-green-50 border-green-200' case 'PENDING': return 'bg-yellow-50 border-yellow-200' case 'FAILED': return 'bg-red-50 border-red-200' default: return 'bg-gray-50 border-gray-200' } } if (loading && transactions.length === 0) { return (
